proposedOverrides.name: Celtic kingdoms
proposedOverrides.summary: A medieval umbrella spanning different British and Irish kingdoms, with shifting map coverage and distinct political histories.

batchIdentityNotes.decision: New single-record contextual card; no aliases. Atlas umbrella changes from Strathclyde/Cumbria to Ireland/Wales/Kintyre at 1000. It is not a coherent empire or proof of uniform sovereignty.
batchIdentityNotes.geometry: 800/900 one southwestern Scotland/northern England polygon. 1000/1100/1200 three components: Wales bbox[-5.247,51.459,-2.749,53.268], Ireland[-10.496,51.434,-5.661,55.253], Kintyre[-5.755,55.329,-5.481,55.668]. Exact decoded seam details in identity.json and components.mjs.
batchIdentityNotes.relatedCards: celts is ancient; scots and picts are distinct early labels; welsh and Irlanda cover earlier regional phases; later Ireland cards are not this shifting umbrella. Do not share any of them automatically.
batchIdentityNotes.limits: The broad 1200 polygon masks English-controlled regions in Wales and Ireland. Kintyre inclusion is an atlas component only, not evidence that it belonged to one Welsh-Irish kingdom. Source narratives are individually localized; no dynasty/ethnicity inferred from polygon.
